question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing sweeper, Bob is playing left midfielder, Claire is playing striker, Dave is playing cheerleader, Eve is playing left back, Fred is playing center midfielder, and Gertrude is playing benchwarmer.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Alice and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Claire and Bob trade positions. Then, Bob and Claire trade positions. Then, Bob and Dave trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Dave trade positions. Then, Claire and Bob trade positions. Finally, Bob and Gertrude trade positions. At the end of the match, Dave is playing
Options:
(A) sweeper
(B) left midfielder
(C) striker
(D) cheerleader
(E) left back
(F) center midfielder
(G) benchwarmer
solution:
Each row lists the positions of Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude, in that order.
Initial: sweeper | left midfielder | striker | cheerleader | left back | center midfielder | benchwarmer
1. Alice ↔ Gertrude: benchwarmer | left midfielder | striker | cheerleader | left back | center midfielder | sweeper
2. Claire ↔ Bob: benchwarmer | striker | left midfielder | cheerleader | left back | center midfielder | sweeper
3. Bob ↔ Claire: benchwarmer | left midfielder | striker | cheerleader | left back | center midfielder | sweeper
4. Bob ↔ Dave: benchwarmer | cheerleader | striker | left midfielder | left back | center midfielder | sweeper
5. Gertrude ↔ Dave: benchwarmer | cheerleader | striker | sweeper | left back | center midfielder | left midfielder
6. Claire ↔ Bob: benchwarmer | striker | cheerleader | sweeper | left back | center midfielder | left midfielder
7. Bob ↔ Gertrude: benchwarmer | left midfielder | cheerleader | sweeper | left back | center midfielder | striker
Dave is playing sweeper, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
